title: RVSD: Retrieval Vision Sparse Decoding for Mitigating Visual Hallucinations in Large Vision-Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2609.02731v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large vision-language models have achieved remarkable success in vision-language tasks. However, they remain prone to Visual Hallucinations (VHs), undermining their reliability in real-world applications. Existing solutions typically require curated datasets, additional training, or multi-round decoding, resulting in considerable computational overhead. In this paper, we propose \textbf{RVSD} (\underline{R}etrieval \underline{V}ision \underline{S}parse \underline{D}ecoding), a training-free and plug-and-play decoding framework that, for the first time, unifies token sparsification and \textbf{Semantic-Space Visual Retrieval} (SSVR) within a single decoding pass. Within RVSD, we introduce a \textbf{semantics-directed token selection} strategy that selectively sparsifies redundant tokens while preserving critical visual information. We further propose the SSVR mechanism, which reformulates visual compensation as an on-demand cross-modal

translated_title: RVSD：用于缓解大型视觉语言模型中视觉幻觉的检索视觉稀疏解码
translated_abstract: 大型视觉语言模型在视觉-语言任务中取得了显著成功。然而，它们仍然容易产生视觉幻觉（VHs），这损害了其在现实应用中的可靠性。现有的解决方案通常需要精心构建的数据集、额外的训练或多轮解码，从而带来相当大的计算开销。在本文中，我们提出了RVSD（检索视觉稀疏解码），这是一个免训练、即插即用的解码框架，首次在单次解码过程中统一了令牌稀疏化与语义空间视觉检索（SSVR）。在RVSD中，我们引入了一种语义导向的令牌选择策略，在保留关键视觉信息的同时选择性地稀疏化冗余令牌。我们进一步提出了SSVR机制，该机制将视觉补偿重新表述为按需的跨模态检索过程……
tldr: 本文提出免训练、即插即用的解码框架RVSD，首次在单次解码中统一令牌稀疏化与语义空间视觉检索（SSVR），以低计算开销缓解大型视觉语言模型的视觉幻觉问题。
en_tdlr: RVSD is a training-free, plug-and-play decoding framework that, for the first time, unifies token sparsification and Semantic-Space Visual Retrieval (SSVR) within a single decoding pass to mitigate visual hallucinations in large vision-language models with low computational overhead.
